name: Baltimore County, Maryland (United States)
description: Quartered: the first and fourth quarters the black and gold Calvert paly-bendy of the Maryland flag, the second a dark red plough on white and the third a dark red cogwheel bearing the Crossland cross on white.
history: Baltimore County is the third-most populous county in Maryland. The flag was adopted on 28 August 1962 (designed by John McLemore, a twelfth-grade student at Parkville Senior High School, selected from thirty entries in a county-wide contest and adopted by executive order on 28 August 1962, according to Flags of the World citing the Maryland State Archives).

features.role: cogwheel bearing the Crossland cross, for industry
